channel.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen — The Marginal Token
channel.description: Changes that affect the cost of buying and running AI.

item.title: AI model releases: 9–15 November 2026
item.description: Fable 5.2 lowers token rates, Gemini 4 Hydrogen reaches the API, and DeepSeek and Perplexity change how common workflows are billed. Token-price pairs give input and output per million tokens. Dollar prices are USD.

item.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen’s Standard token rates match Flash from January
item.description: Hydrogen’s paid input and output rates are double Gemini 3.8 Flash’s introductory rates through 31 December. Their cache rates differ from January.

item.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen: launch
item.description: 2026-11-12: Gemini 4 Hydrogen becomes generally available on the free and paid Gemini API tiers. Source: https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog#11-12-2026
